read_parts: Main algorithm and label-correction equations; appendix schedule; full official Train_cifar.py andREADME.
relevant_idea: Separate directly supervised examples when using a peer model for label correction; the method is established prior art, not a new invention here.
code_limits_for_our_setting: Official warmup trains both models on the whole dataset, so its code is not strict zero-exposure cross-fitting.
Official training chooses checkpoints using test-set accuracy. Our targetGT rule forbids copying that selection.
Official method includes JSD normalization, sharpening, SSL and image augmentations. Our proposed correlated-opinion feedback is not an exact CrossSplit reproduction.
our_inference: Current joint teacher fits show little change from their initial teacher opinions. Track-group-disjoint image priors are a testable candidate to reduce direct memorization.
